title: Humdingers, the game I'm making
summary: Besides StarCraft: Brood War and StarCraft II, the only games I've ever been this passionate about are EarthBound on the SNES and Mother 3. So I'm making a spiritual successor. Worlds 1 and 2 are playable free in your browser, on phone or desktop. Watch the demo or start a New Game.
highlights: Play on a phone with touch controls, or on a computer with a keyboard or gamepad.
Open it from the home page or the Arcade tab. No account needed.
It's about a 10 MB download. Not affiliated with Nintendo.

title: Find the new tools in one place
summary: Open Tools in the website menu or Explore tools in the signed-in dashboard to find released features.
highlights: Play SC2 Daily or Daily Scout, or run a series in Match Rooms.
Open Ladder Balance, check a claim with Balance Receipts or compare a record with Whine Permit.
Find Balance Court, 2026 Wrapped and Replay Career under Analyze your replays when browser analysis is available.

title: Choose when your play session ends
summary: Your live session record, session quizzes and personal Trends now share your session setting.
highlights: Set 15–480 minutes, or use Auto, in Settings → Profile.
Auto keeps four hours for overlay accounts and uses 90 minutes for other accounts.
An exact gap stays connected, including across midnight.

title: Your activity and report replies in one inbox
summary: Notifications now bring together sync results, coaching updates and replies from SC2 Tools.
highlights: Find the bell beside your account menu, even when Reviews are unavailable.
Filter the full inbox and choose which updates you receive.
Read replies to your reports in Settings → Help → My reports.

title: Check your PC before linking it
summary: Pairing shows the PC details before you confirm and waits for its first real connection.
highlights: Paste a pairing code or open the link from the desktop app.
Check the PC name and operating system before confirming.
Give devices a label and check their latest connection in Devices.

title: Stream controls recover without losing your draft
summary: The Stream Dock explains connection trouble and keeps unsaved controls ready for Retry.
highlights: See when a control is reconnecting or still loading.
Retry a failed save with your current form values.
Polls, goals and scene controls confirm successful saves.
